question: In which year was the first Economic Survey presented as part of the Union Budget?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950 - 51**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first Economic Survey was presented as part of the Union Budget in the year **1950 - 51**.
 
• The Economic Survey is an annual document released by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, before the Union Budget.
 
• It provides a detailed account of the country's economic performance over the past year and outlines the economic outlook and policy challenges for the upcoming year.
 
• The Economic Survey is an important document for policymakers, economists, and the general public to understand the state of the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Economic Survey is usually presented a day before the Union Budget in the Parliament.
 
• It is prepared under the guidance of the Chief Economic Adviser to the Government of India.
 
• The document comprises two parts: Part A deals with economic issues and policy options, while Part B provides statistical data on various economic indicators.
 
• The insights and data from the Economic Survey help in formulating the budget and economic policies for the upcoming fiscal year.
